name: coreloop-site-monorepo
description: TypeScript rewrite of the Lab-Lace IT Software & Solutions site: shared domain model, Vite frontend, Express/PM2 backend.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm test -w packages/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/backend && npm run typecheck -w packages/frontend
scripts.pm2:start: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/backend && pm2 start packages/backend/ecosystem.config.cjs
